schema_note: v4.3 法定对账方法论 — 应对评审'EPSG:4548 唯一权威值'过度断言。定义触发条件（正式控规或文保管控边界进入 approved_formal_sources）、三级冲突等级（参数偏离/功能冲突/物理不可行）、双语处置规则。所有对账结果记入 difference-ledger 并随 90 天公示期披露；正式发布前不假设任何控规值。

trigger.condition_zh: 官方控规图则或文保管控边界正式发布并进入 data/source_registry.json 的 approved_formal_sources 后启动校核
trigger.condition_en: Reconciliation starts once official regulatory-plan drawings or heritage-control boundaries are formally released and enter approved_formal_sources in data/source_registry.json
trigger.current_state_zh: 所有空间边界与面积均为 provisional，仅作概念建议，禁止作为正式红线或法定精确面积依据
trigger.current_state_en: All spatial boundaries and areas are provisional; conceptual only; NOT to be treated as official redline or legally-precise area basis

conflict_levels.definition_zh: 局部参数偏离：设计模型值与图则管控值存在参数级差异，不改变要素功能
conflict_levels.definition_en: Local parameter deviation: design-model values differ from statutory control values at parameter level without changing element function
conflict_levels.disposition_zh: 校核并更新设计模型值，差异记入台账
conflict_levels.disposition_en: Check and update design-model values; record the difference in ledger

conflict_levels.definition_zh: 功能冲突：管控要求使要素功能无法按原设计成立
conflict_levels.definition_en: Functional conflict: control requirements render element function unworkable as designed
conflict_levels.disposition_zh: 要素降级为概念占位，待专项深化
conflict_levels.disposition_en: Downgrade the element to conceptual placeholder pending specialist deepening

conflict_levels.definition_zh: 物理不可行：设计模型与图则管控在物理上无法并存
conflict_levels.definition_en: Physically infeasible: design-model and statutory control cannot co-exist physically
conflict_levels.disposition_zh: 撤销该设计要素，记入台账并触发预案
conflict_levels.disposition_en: Withdraw the design element; record in ledger; trigger contingency plan

element_control_matrix_preview_zh: L1/L2 处置预案就绪（须文保协议）
difference_ledger_zh: 差异台账：对账完成后所有 L1/L2/L3 项进入台账，差异标注来源、对账时间、处置结论
difference_ledger_en: Difference ledger: after reconciliation, all L1/L2/L3 items enter ledger with source, reconciliation timestamp, disposition conclusion
public_disclosure_zh: 90 天公示期：台账通过 project 公示渠道公开
public_disclosure_en: 90-day public review: ledger published via project disclosure channel
v2_4_1_status_note: v2.4.1 中'EPSG:4548 投影面积作为当前 provisional 模型基线（唯一权威值须以组织方发布的正式 polygon 为准）'的表述已不再使用'唯一权威'用词；本方法论取代为分级冲突对账。
v2_4_1_status_note_en: The v2.4.1 wording 'EPSG:4548 projected area as the sole authoritative basis' is replaced by graded-conflict reconciliation; no element is treated as 'authoritative' before official release.
